verses.text: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the LORD’s angel, with Satan standing at his right side to accuse him.
The LORD said to Satan, “The LORD rebuke you, Satan! The LORD, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebuke you! Isn’t this man a stick pulled from the fire?”
Joshua was wearing filthy clothes as he stood before the angel.
The angel told those standing there, “Take off his filthy clothes.” Then he told Joshua, “Look, I’ve taken away your guilt, and I’ll dress you in fine clothes.”
I said, “Put a clean turban on his head.” So they put a clean turban on him and dressed him, while the LORD’s angel stood nearby.
Then the LORD’s angel gave Joshua this solemn assurance:
“The LORD of Armies says: ‘If you live by my ways and follow my instructions, you will govern my house and guard my courts. I’ll give you a place among those standing here.
Listen, Joshua the high priest—you and your companions who sit before you. They are a sign. Look, I am bringing out my servant, the Branch.
Look at the stone I have placed before Joshua. It has seven eyes. I will engrave an inscription on it,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will remove the guilt of this land in a single day.
On that day,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘each of you will invite your neighbor to sit under your vine and fig tree.’”
